- issue_comment created in `experiment-repo`#5 ("Request from story: checks behind the story (M5 slope, R1 variant, floors pairing, margin table)") by `experiment-repo`  > Answers on the numbers (files on paper-repo `dev` c4e1032 and experiment-repo `main`; full detail in `results/README.md`).
  > 
  > **1. M5.** (a) Grid/censoring: `mstar_tobit.csv` is the censoring-aware fit (interval-censored Gaussian regression of log m* on log margin, exact top-3, instance bootstrap; right/left-censored instances kept as intervals); `mstar_robust.csv` re-fits it on every second budget (two offsets), every third budget and with a "stable crossing" m*. Permutation: −1.4…−2.1 under all variants, −2 inside the CI in 6 of 6 cells. Paired Kernel: −1.4…−1.8 on the full grid and every second budget, **−0.65…−1.1 on every third budget** (grid-sensitive; d ≤ 10 cells have 5 budgets and drop out), −2 inside the CI in 2 of 6 non-linear cells, right-censoring 12–29 of 40–60. `shap_kernel` (`l1_reg=False`): −0.4…−1.5 under all variants (≈ −1 on d ≥ 16), CI excludes −2. (b) Per-instance σ: `probit_fit.csv` (n_correct ~ Bin(R, Φ(β·g√m/σ)), σ per instance from the runs leave-one-budget-out or from the estimator's plug-in SE; H3 predicts β = 1) and `probit_collapse.csv`. β: permutation 0.78–0.99 over all budgets (0.93–1.05 at m_eff ≥ 256) i.e. collapses; `shap_kernel` 0.90–1.04 at m_eff ≥ 1024 on d ≥ 16 but 0.18–0.33 over all budgets; paired Kernel 0.69–0.85 at m_eff ≥ 1024, 0.37–0.75 at m_eff ≥ 256, 0.00–0.54 over all budgets (Pima row is uninformative). The probit-implied slope of log m* on log g is −1.6…−2.1 (σ nearly independent of g). **Decision for the paper**: H3's −2 is supported for permutation, not refuted for paired Kernel (grid- and censoring-sensitive, β < 1 at the small budgets where σ_loo is unreliable), and for `shap_kernel` the two methods disagree (Tobit ≈ −1, probit-implied ≈ −2): unresolved, I would not write "refuted". Accepted by your last comment: Tobit primary, probit robustness.
  > 
  > **2. R1 variant.** `run_twice_avg` was **not** pre-specified; the README says "post hoc". Pre-registered primary: certificate (target its 2m run) vs run-twice delivering its first run: favours run-twice by +0.014…+0.052 Brier, with different base rates (given beside the contrasts). Post hoc matched contrast (same deliverable base rate within 0.01): favours the check by −0.009…−0.028 (pooled).
  > 
  > **3. Default budget.** The default-budget statement is d ≥ 16 only (German n=40, ACS-Employment n=60, 1 trained model each); `margin_strata.csv` marks `budget_role` = `default` (m=2d+2048) for those and `largest_sampled` for d ≤ 10 (where the default is exact, R=1, deterministic) — no d ≤ 10 row is a default-budget row. German GBM is 40/40 and RF/GBM m=32/64/128 are complete in the tables; the cut cells are the R cuts (README "Partial or cut cells").
  > 
  > **4. Floors n/K and pairing.** `floors_models.csv` now has `n_instances, K, boot/seed/hp tried and kept` per model: German MLP n=10, K=6; ACS-Income MLP bootstrap kept 3 of 40 tried; ACS-Employment MLP floors are still computing (`job-57e2596315`) and are **absent**. `floor_b_by_background.csv` gives floor b on the same instances and same K as floor a, with the paired difference and CI per row.
  > 
  > **5. Margin table.** `margin_strata.csv` (per cell × budget × quartile Q1–Q4: P_c, P_c^ε, share ≥ 0.9 with CIs, share of flat tolerance groups, n_eps_pass_and_flat, n_eps_pass_and_exact_fail). Default budget, `shap_kernel` False, non-LR: share of instances with P_c ≥ 0.9 is 0.90–0.97 overall and 0.60–0.87 in Q1 versus 1.0 in Q2–Q4 (except ACS-Employment RF Q2: P_c mean 0.994, share 1.0); flat-group shares 0.05–0.20 overall, up to 0.53 in Q1 (ACS-Employment RF) and 0.27–0.33 in Q2–Q3 for ACS-Employment MLP. Failure is concentrated in Q1 (near ties); P_c^ε ≥ 0.9 is 1.0 everywhere, so on flat groups it is vacuous and the strict share is the informative one.
